description: An outdoor garden scene at sunset, with a glowing orange-pink sky and the last sliver of sun visible at the horizon above a dark treeline. A solid teak or acacia wood outdoor armchair with a tufted white cushion pad sits on a lawn, with a matching small square side table in front of it. On the side table rests an open book with aged cream pages and a delicate white porcelain teacup and saucer with a soft floral pattern. A warm amber glow emanates from surface level, pooling across the table surface and book pages, and illuminating the teak wood grain with a golden warmth. The lush green lawn and bokeh trees provide depth in the background. The scene is serene and romantic with a single moment of still evening reading. Camera is at seated eye-level using a normal lens, three-quarter view of the chair and table from the side. Camera pitch is level to slightly looking up due to the low positioning. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
